$Comment: Elsie the Weaver, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while Harvest Feast
runs, so a player carrying the invitation tour always has somebody to ask. The role, this placement
and the conversation pressing F opens all ship in this pack. Interact names the conversation
(Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Weaver.json). Author Dialogue or Open, never both.
Season makes Elsie a guest, as it does the host: the placement stands only while the calendar event
Harvest_Feast is switched on and running, and the library looks at every placement again at each
start and end, so neither needs a restart. Lifecycle keeps her chunk loaded, stands her up again if
something removes her, and raises her health past anything that can be dealt.
Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id, which stays the same on every visit while the
world's name does not. Identity.NpcId is spelled as the role, so a nameplate key built from it
resolves. Each villager has an id and a conversation of their own: the invitation line is spent per
conversation, so two villagers sharing one would count as one person asked.
Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset: eleven blocks along negative X, onto the open
landing, and two back along negative Z, on the host's side and well past the host's spot. To move
Elsie, edit Anchor.WorldSpawn.Offset (small enough to stay off the walls) and Yaw to turn her, then
look at the spot in game. To take her out without editing this file, set enabled (lower case, as
that file spells it) to false for this id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Weaver_Temple
